name: Gustavo Dudamel
scope: Dedicated Dudamel audit using actual shared/engine.ts and production sprite, presentation and match renderers. Only this report and tests/character-audits/dudamel.test.ts were written. No runtime edits, art edits, commits, server starts or child agents.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: The existing dossier identifies Gustavo Dudamel as an orchestra conductor formed in El Sistema and specifies curly salt-and-pepper hair, clean-shaven face, dark concert tailcoat, light shirt and white baton. No new broad research was conducted.
identityAndPortrayal.visualMatch: The existing arcade adaptation retains the short dense curls, clean-shaven face, dark formal tailcoat/waistcoat/trousers, white collar/tie and straight conducting baton. The eight combat frames and twelve painted entrance poses are coherent in both facings. No likeness or clothing change is requested.
identityAndPortrayal.audio: Dossier specifies generic nonverbal effort/pain, no real voice and cadenza cue. Source inspection shows synthesized conducting entrance tones. No dialogue was added; audio listening was not performed.

movementAndStance.jump: First jump reaches y454.6 after10 frames. Second jump is accepted, third rejected;100 idle frames restore y554, grounded=true and jumps0 with two stocks.
movementAndStance.visual: Inspected actual drawSprite frames0–7 in both facings: idle0, guard1, walk2/3, jump4, light/special5, heavy6 and hurt7. Head, curls, hands, baton and feet remained intact with no wrong-facing pose or neighboring shoe fragment observed.

special.name: Cadenza de rebote
special.strikeReproduction: Advance the full510-tick intro on poliedro. P1 Dudamel x180/Javier x260, or P2 Dudamel x900/Javier x820; both on floor y554 with100 energy. Increment Dudamel special once. Idle Javier or rear guard (block plus right for P1 Dudamel, left for P2 Dudamel) takes one hit at tick534/attackTick24, loses9.991HP and finishes90.009HP. Frontal block preserves100HP and records0 Dudamel hits. Through attackTick23 the target retains100HP. Dudamel remains at his starting x and spawns no projectile.

special.naturalReflectionReproduction: At intro completion tick510, P1 Dudamel x180/Renny x380, or mirrored P2 Dudamel x900/Renny x700, on floor with100 energy. Increment both specials on the same step and otherwise keep inputs idle for100 steps. Renny emits broadcast at combat tick10. At tick12 Dudamel reflects it; sender is hit on tick14 before the second broadcast can emit.

special.boundaryProbeMethod: Generate one real Renny broadcast with ten engine steps at gap400. Set rival attack=null to isolate that projectile; place shot y=-500/life120 while Dudamel reaches sampled frame, then position the shot before one real engine step. This is fixture positioning around the actual engine, not a mocked engine. Start Dudamel x180 on side0 or x900 on side1 and Renny x580/x500.
special.boundaryResults: Both sides: frame4 rejects,5 accepts,22 accepts,23 rejects. At frame5, front offset139.9 reflects while140 does not; rear overlap-20 reflects while-21 does not. Vertical offset94.9 relative to y479 reflects while95 does not. The -20 allowance is the existing overlap tolerance, not an added rear reflection feature. Rear offset-21 hits Dudamel for7.92HP with original ownership.
special.reflectedGuardProbe: Use the same actual projectile probe at frame5/front offset100. Place sender280 pixels in front, then advance90 frames with idle, front block or rear block plus movement away. Idle/rear block leave sender92.24HP and award one Dudamel hit; front block leaves100HP and0 hits. Dudamel remains100HP in all cases. Both player sides were exercised.

attacksAndCombos.recognitionGate: At gap140, two intentionally whiffed lights followed by heavy preserve existing input-history recognition:0 wins yields Primer compás/bonus3;1 win yields Cambio de tempo/bonus7. Connected-combo probes independently establish actual hit delivery.
attacksAndCombos.super: Gran cadenza requires3 wins and75 energy. Zero/two wins or74 energy reject on both sides. At gap200,3 wins/100 energy gives one tick9 hit for(28*.97+12)*1.03=40.3348HP, leaving59.6652HP.

cpuFight.method: Complete shared510-tick intro, keep Dudamel idle180 frames to exercise CPU offense, then approach to85 pixels with real guard/jump/attack counters. Run the whole controller twice and deep-compare complete final states.
cpuFight.limit: One exercised deterministic normal-CPU bout, not a balance benchmark. Both player sides are independently covered by movement, attacks, special/reflection, guards and combo tests.
